title: The Campaign to Bring Jensen Back
summary: Nvidia makes the computer chips that power artificial intelligence. Its co-founder Jensen Huang was the boss of the company. Last week, he stepped down from his job. Now many people want him back. More than 175,000 people have signed a letter asking the company's board to give Huang his job back. The group calls itself Bring Jensen Back. It says Huang was removed without a fair process. The group has famous friends. President Donald Trump said he would not mind if Huang got his job back. Elon Musk, the head of SpaceX, and Tim Sweeney, the boss of Fortnite maker Epic Games, also support him. But Nvidia says no. The company has dismissed the campaign. A newspaper reported that Huang has talked with friends about coming back, but the board is not thinking about giving him the job. A person who speaks for Huang did not want to comment. The story has also started a debate in Washington about who should run Nvidia next.
why_it_matters: The chips in phones and games come from companies like Nvidia, so who runs them matters for the tech kids use.
